p.t: Unexpected Improvements to Expected Improvement for Bayesian Optimization
p.d: 研究贝叶斯优化中期望改进采集函数的数值稳定性，通过改进其计算方式帮助算法更可靠地选择下一次评估的位置。
p.e: Studies the numerical stability of the expected-improvement acquisition function in Bayesian optimization, improving how it is computed so the algorithm more reliably chooses where to evaluate next.

p.t: Large Language Models to Enhance Bayesian Optimization
p.d: 探索如何将大语言模型的先验知识引入贝叶斯优化，用于辅助搜索昂贵黑箱函数的较优解。
p.e: Explores bringing the prior knowledge of large language models into Bayesian optimization to help search for good solutions of expensive black-box functions.

p.t: Bayesian Optimization of Function Networks with Partial Evaluations
p.d: 面向由多个函数组成的计算网络，研究只评估部分模块时如何开展贝叶斯优化，以减少不必要的整体计算。
p.e: For computation networks made of several functions, studies how to run Bayesian optimization when only some modules are evaluated, avoiding unnecessary full computations.

p.t: Scaling Multi-Task Bayesian Optimization with Large Language Models
p.d: 研究借助大语言模型扩展多任务贝叶斯优化，让多个优化任务中的信息能够被共同利用。
p.e: Uses large language models to scale multi-task Bayesian optimization so that information from many optimization tasks can be shared.

p.t: Unleashing LLMs in Bayesian Optimization: Preference-Guided Framework for Scientific Discovery
p.d: 探索把偏好信息与大语言模型结合起来指导贝叶斯优化，面向科学发现中的候选搜索问题。
p.e: Combines preference information with large language models to guide Bayesian optimization for candidate search in scientific discovery.

p.t: Deep Batch Active Learning by Diverse, Uncertain Gradient Lower Bounds
p.d: 在主动学习中兼顾样本的不确定性与多样性，选择更值得人工标注的一批数据，减少重复或低价值的标注。
p.e: Balances uncertainty and diversity in active learning to pick batches that are most worth labelling, reducing redundant or low-value annotation.

p.t: Active Preference Learning for Large Language Models
p.d: 研究如何主动挑选大语言模型最需要学习的偏好样本，让有限的反馈预算用于更有信息量的比较。
p.e: Studies how to actively choose the preference examples a large language model most needs, so a limited feedback budget goes to more informative comparisons.

p.t: Active Learning of Deep Neural Networks via Gradient-Free Cutting Planes
p.d: 探索不依赖梯度的切平面方法来选择深度网络的主动学习样本，关注有限标注预算下的信息获取。
p.e: Explores gradient-free cutting-plane methods for selecting active-learning samples for deep networks, focusing on information gain under a limited labelling budget.

p.t: A Minimalist Approach to Offline Reinforcement Learning
p.d: 以简洁的离线强化学习方法为出发点，将策略学习与行为克隆结合，使智能体能够利用已有数据学习动作。
p.e: Starts from a minimalist offline reinforcement learning method that combines policy learning with behaviour cloning, letting agents learn actions from existing data.

p.t: Revisiting the Minimalist Approach to Offline Reinforcement Learning
p.d: 重新审视简洁的离线强化学习方案，研究设计和训练选择如何影响从固定数据集学习策略的效果。
p.e: Revisits minimalist offline reinforcement learning, examining how design and training choices affect learning policies from a fixed dataset.

p.t: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
p.d: 将生成过程写成从噪声逐步恢复数据的去噪过程，是理解扩散模型训练与采样机制的重要基础。
p.e: Frames generation as a denoising process that gradually recovers data from noise; a key foundation for understanding how diffusion models are trained and sampled.

p.t: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers
p.d: 用 Transformer 构建扩散生成模型，研究模型架构与规模扩展如何支持更强的图像生成能力。
p.e: Builds diffusion models on Transformers, studying how architecture and scaling support stronger image generation.

p.t: DiGress: Discrete Denoising Diffusion for Graph Generation
p.d: 将扩散去噪应用到离散图结构，学习生成节点及其连接关系，面向分子等图数据的生成任务。
p.e: Applies diffusion denoising to discrete graphs, learning to generate nodes and their connections for tasks such as molecule generation.

p.t: Crystal Structure Prediction by Joint Equivariant Diffusion
p.d: 用联合等变扩散方法预测晶体结构，关注晶格与原子位置之间的协调，以及结构对称性在生成中的作用。
p.e: Predicts crystal structures with joint equivariant diffusion, coordinating lattice and atomic positions and exploiting structural symmetry during generation.

p.t: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
p.d: 通过学习连续变化的速度场，把简单分布中的样本逐步输送到目标数据分布，为生成建模提供流匹配框架。
p.e: Learns a continuously varying velocity field that transports samples from a simple distribution to the data distribution, providing the flow matching framework for generative modelling.

p.t: Flow Matching on General Geometries
p.d: 将流匹配推广到更一般的几何空间，研究数据受曲面或流形约束时如何构建生成过程。
p.e: Extends flow matching to general geometric spaces, studying how to build generative processes when data are constrained to curved surfaces or manifolds.

p.t: Discrete Flow Matching
p.d: 把流匹配的思想扩展到离散状态空间，研究如何通过离散状态转换生成目标数据。
p.e: Extends flow matching to discrete state spaces, generating target data through transitions between discrete states.

p.t: Trajectory Balance: Improved Credit Assignment in GFlowNets
p.d: 提出面向 GFlowNet 的轨迹平衡训练目标，关注如何将最终候选的奖励传回生成路径中的各个决策。
p.e: Proposes the trajectory balance objective for GFlowNets, addressing how the reward of a final candidate is propagated back to each decision along the generation path.

p.t: Multi-Objective GFlowNets
p.d: 研究同时面对多个目标时的 GFlowNet 生成，让候选搜索能够覆盖不同目标权衡下的多样解。
p.e: Studies GFlowNet generation with multiple objectives, so candidate search can cover diverse solutions across different trade-offs.

p.t: Generalization and Distributed Learning of GFlowNets
p.d: 研究 GFlowNet 的泛化与分布式学习，关注生成策略如何利用不同来源的探索经验。
p.e: Studies generalisation and distributed learning in GFlowNets, focusing on how a generation policy can use exploration experience from different sources.

p.t: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
p.d: 把外部文档检索与语言模型生成结合起来，让模型能够参考检索到的材料回答知识密集型问题。
p.e: Combines retrieval of external documents with language model generation, letting the model consult retrieved material to answer knowledge-intensive questions.

p.t: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
p.d: 让模型学习判断何时检索，并对生成内容进行自我反思与评判，将检索和回答质量控制结合起来。
p.e: Teaches the model to decide when to retrieve and to reflect on and critique its own output, combining retrieval with control of answer quality.

p.t: DeepRAG: Thinking to Retrieve Step by Step for Large Language Models
p.d: 研究将逐步推理与检索交织起来的回答流程，让复杂问题的信息需求在推理过程中逐步被处理。
p.e: Studies an answering process that interleaves step-by-step reasoning with retrieval, so the information needs of complex questions are handled progressively during reasoning.

p.t: Improving Text Embeddings with Large Language Models
p.d: 通过两步提示生成多样任务与合成样本，再用单阶段对比学习微调 Mistral-7B，得到可由任务指令定制的文本嵌入。
p.e: Generates diverse tasks and synthetic examples with two-step prompting, then fine-tunes Mistral-7B in a single contrastive stage to produce instruction-customisable text embeddings.

p.t: NV-Embed: Improved Techniques for Training LLMs as Generalist Embedding Models
p.d: 研究将大语言模型训练为通用文本嵌入模型的改进技术，目标是让同一套向量表示服务于多种文本理解与检索任务。
p.e: Studies improved techniques for training large language models as general-purpose text embedding models, so one set of vectors serves many text understanding and retrieval tasks.

p.t: Unified Structure Generation for Universal Information Extraction
p.d: 把不同的信息抽取任务统一为结构化内容生成，使用同一种建模形式提取实体、关系等信息。
p.e: Unifies different information extraction tasks as structured generation, extracting entities, relations and more with a single modelling form.

p.t: Instruct and Extract: Instruction Tuning for On-Demand Information Extraction
p.d: 通过指令微调进行按需信息抽取，让模型根据用户描述的需求从文本中提取目标信息。
p.e: Uses instruction tuning for on-demand information extraction, letting the model pull out whatever information the user describes.

p.t: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
p.d: 把语言推理与工具行动交替组织起来，让智能体在获取外部反馈后继续调整思路和行动。
p.e: Interleaves language reasoning with tool actions, so an agent keeps adjusting its thinking and actions after receiving external feedback.

p.t: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
p.d: 研究让语言模型学习调用工具，包括何时调用、如何传递参数，以及怎样将工具结果用于后续生成。
p.e: Teaches language models to use tools: when to call them, how to pass arguments and how to use the results in later generation.

p.t: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
p.d: 让语言智能体将任务反馈整理成文字反思，并在后续尝试中利用这些经验改进行动。
p.e: Has language agents turn task feedback into written reflections and use that experience to improve their actions in later attempts.

p.t: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
p.d: 对同一问题采样多条推理路径，再综合其答案的一致性，减少单次推理偶然出错的影响。
p.e: Samples multiple reasoning paths for the same question and aggregates their answers by consistency, reducing the effect of a single faulty chain.

p.t: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
p.d: 把推理过程组织成可探索的思维树，通过评估和选择不同分支来处理需要规划的问题。
p.e: Organises reasoning as an explorable tree of thoughts, evaluating and selecting branches to handle problems that require planning.

p.t: Language Agent Tree Search Unifies Reasoning, Acting, and Planning in Language Models
p.d: 将树搜索引入语言智能体，把推理、行动与规划放进同一个搜索过程，探索不同决策路径。
p.e: Brings tree search to language agents, placing reasoning, acting and planning in one search process to explore different decision paths.

p.t: MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework
p.d: 将多智能体协作组织为具有分工的工作流程，研究多个语言模型角色如何共同完成复杂任务。
p.e: Organises multi-agent collaboration as a workflow with division of labour, studying how several language-model roles complete complex tasks together.

p.t: ReConcile: Round-Table Conference Improves Reasoning via Consensus among Diverse LLMs
p.d: 让不同语言模型通过多轮讨论形成共识，研究模型间的信息交换如何辅助复杂问题推理。
p.e: Has different language models reach consensus through multi-round discussion, studying how information exchange between models aids complex reasoning.

p.m: NeurIPS · Datasets & Benchmarks 2023 · 框架入口
p.t: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
p.d: 研究用语言模型评审及人类偏好比较评估对话模型，并通过 MT-Bench 与 Chatbot Arena 探索评测的一致性与偏差。
p.e: Studies evaluating chat models with LLM judges and human preference comparisons, using MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena to examine agreement and bias.

p.t: G-Eval: NLG Evaluation using GPT-4 with Better Human Alignment
p.d: 使用 GPT-4 评估生成文本的质量，研究自动评价如何更贴近人类对文本的判断。
p.e: Uses GPT-4 to evaluate the quality of generated text, studying how automatic evaluation can better match human judgement.

p.t: Prometheus: Inducing Fine-Grained Evaluation Capability in Language Models
p.d: 训练能够依据细粒度评价标准给出反馈的语言模型，面向生成内容的自动评审与评分。
p.e: Trains a language model that gives feedback according to fine-grained rubrics, for automatic review and scoring of generated content.

p.t: FActScore: Fine-Grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation
p.d: 将长文本拆分为可核查的原子事实，并评价其中有多少得到证据支持，使事实性评价更加细致。
p.e: Splits long-form text into checkable atomic facts and measures how many are supported by evidence, making factuality evaluation more fine-grained.

p.t: Long-form Factuality in Large Language Models
p.d: 面向语言模型生成的长篇回答，研究如何系统检查其中的事实性，并构建相应评测任务。
p.e: Studies how to systematically check the factuality of long answers generated by language models, and builds a corresponding benchmark.

p.t: Conformal Risk Control
p.d: 将共形方法用于风险控制，研究如何借助校准数据使模型输出满足预设的风险要求。
p.e: Applies conformal methods to risk control, using calibration data so that model outputs meet a prescribed risk level.

p.t: Conformal Language Modeling
p.d: 将共形预测引入语言建模，探索如何为语言模型的输出提供经过校准的不确定性控制。
p.e: Brings conformal prediction to language modelling, exploring calibrated uncertainty control for language model outputs.

p.t: Language Models with Conformal Factuality Guarantees
p.d: 研究利用共形方法控制语言模型回答的事实性风险，关注生成内容与统计保证之间的联系。
p.e: Uses conformal methods to control the factuality risk of language model answers, linking generated content to statistical guarantees.

p.t: CoFact: Conformal Factuality Guarantees for Language Models under Covariate Shift
p.d: 研究输入分布发生协变量偏移时，如何为语言模型维持共形事实性保证。
p.e: Studies how to maintain conformal factuality guarantees for language models when the input distribution undergoes covariate shift.

p.t: Domain-Shift-Aware Conformal Prediction for Large Language Models
p.d: 研究面向领域变化的共形预测，使语言模型的不确定性处理能够考虑训练与应用环境之间的分布差异。
p.e: Studies conformal prediction under domain shift, so uncertainty handling in language models accounts for differences between training and deployment distributions.

p.t: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model Is Secretly a Reward Model
p.d: 直接利用偏好比较数据优化语言模型，使模型更倾向于生成用户偏好的回答，简化偏好对齐流程。
p.e: Optimises language models directly on preference comparison data so they favour preferred responses, simplifying preference alignment.

p.t: SimPO: Simple Preference Optimization with a Reference-Free Reward
p.d: 研究不依赖参考模型的简单偏好优化方法，降低语言模型偏好训练中的流程复杂度。
p.e: Studies a simple preference optimization method that needs no reference model, reducing the complexity of preference training.

p.t: Model Alignment as Prospect Theoretic Optimization
p.d: 从前景理论的角度设计模型对齐目标，探索如何利用对输出好坏的反馈来调整语言模型行为。
p.e: Designs an alignment objective from the perspective of prospect theory, exploring how feedback on whether outputs are good or bad can adjust model behaviour.

p.t: MiniLLM: Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models
p.d: 研究大语言模型的知识蒸馏，使较小的学生模型能够学习较大教师模型的生成行为。
p.e: Studies knowledge distillation for large language models so a smaller student can learn the generation behaviour of a larger teacher.

p.t: DistiLLM: Towards Streamlined Distillation for Large Language Models
p.d: 探索更精简的大语言模型蒸馏流程，关注如何有效地将教师模型的能力传递给学生模型。
p.e: Explores a more streamlined distillation pipeline for large language models, focusing on transferring teacher capabilities to the student effectively.

p.t: DistiLLM-2: A Contrastive Approach Boosts the Distillation of LLMs
p.d: 将对比学习思路引入语言模型蒸馏，研究通过区分不同生成样本来改进教师到学生的知识迁移。
p.e: Brings contrastive ideas into language model distillation, improving teacher-to-student transfer by distinguishing between different generated samples.

p.t: Large Language Model Unlearning
p.d: 研究让大语言模型遗忘指定知识或数据影响的方法，面向训练后知识移除与模型行为调整。
p.e: Studies methods for making large language models forget specified knowledge or the influence of specific data, for post-training knowledge removal and behaviour adjustment.

p.t: Invariance Makes LLM Unlearning Resilient Even to Unanticipated Downstream Fine-Tuning
p.d: 研究怎样使语言模型的遗忘效果在后续微调后仍能保持，关注被移除知识重新显现的问题。
p.e: Studies how to keep unlearning effective after later fine-tuning, addressing the re-emergence of removed knowledge.

p.t: Improved Distribution Matching for Dataset Condensation
p.d: 通过改进分布匹配来进行数据集浓缩，把较大数据集中的训练信息压缩到更小的合成数据集。
p.e: Improves distribution matching for dataset condensation, compressing the training information of a large dataset into a much smaller synthetic one.

p.t: DREAM: Efficient Dataset Distillation by Representative Matching
p.d: 利用代表性匹配进行数据集蒸馏，研究如何选取和匹配更有代表性的训练信息以提高蒸馏效率。
p.e: Uses representative matching for dataset distillation, studying how selecting and matching more representative training information improves efficiency.

p.t: Towards Stable Test-Time Adaptation in Dynamic Wild World
p.d: 研究动态测试环境中的模型适应，关注输入不断变化时如何避免测试时更新造成不稳定。
p.e: Studies model adaptation in dynamic test environments, focusing on avoiding instability from test-time updates as inputs keep changing.

p.t: Robust Test-Time Adaptation in Dynamic Scenarios
p.d: 面向动态场景开展鲁棒测试时适应，研究模型如何在持续变化的数据流中调整自身。
p.e: Develops robust test-time adaptation for dynamic scenes, studying how a model adjusts itself on a continually changing data stream.

p.t: Test-Time Adaptation with Binary Feedback
p.d: 研究仅利用二元反馈进行测试时适应，让模型在缺少完整标签的情况下借助简化反馈调整。
p.e: Studies test-time adaptation with only binary feedback, letting a model adjust with simplified signals when full labels are unavailable.

p.t: Equiformer: Equivariant Graph Attention Transformer for 3D Atomistic Graphs
p.d: 将等变性与图注意力结合起来建模三维原子体系，使模型在空间旋转等变换下保持合理的几何响应。
p.e: Combines equivariance with graph attention to model 3D atomic systems, so the model responds correctly to spatial rotations and other transformations.

p.t: EquiformerV2: Improved Equivariant Transformer for Scaling to Higher-Degree Representations
p.d: 改进等变 Transformer 对高阶几何表示的处理，探索更可扩展的三维原子体系建模方式。
p.e: Improves how equivariant Transformers handle higher-order geometric representations, exploring more scalable modelling of 3D atomic systems.

p.d: 利用温度驱动的主动学习构建 MOF 机器学习势，研究如何选择训练构型以近似量子化学能量与作用力。
p.e: Builds machine-learned potentials for MOFs with temperature-driven active learning, studying how to choose training configurations that approximate quantum-chemical energies and forces.

p.m: ACS Nano 2025 · 计算＋机器学习势
p.t: Toward a Generalizable Machine-Learned Potential for Metal–Organic Frameworks
p.d: 探索可泛化的 MOF 机器学习势，关注势能模型在不同框架或构型之间的适用范围。
p.e: Explores generalisable machine-learned potentials for MOFs, focusing on how far a potential applies across frameworks and configurations.

p.m: Chemistry of Materials 2025 · 多尺度计算
p.t: Cluster-Based Machine Learning Potentials to Describe Disordered Metal–Organic Frameworks up to the Mesoscale
p.d: 以簇为基础构建机器学习势，面向无序 MOF 从局域配位结构到介观尺度的描述。
p.e: Builds cluster-based machine-learned potentials to describe disordered MOFs from local coordination up to the mesoscale.

p.t: A scalable metal-organic framework as a durable physisorbent for carbon dioxide capture
p.d: 研究可规模化制备的 CALF-20 作为耐用物理吸附剂用于 CO₂ 捕集，连接材料性能与实际应用需求。
p.e: Studies scalable CALF-20 as a durable physisorbent for CO₂ capture, linking material performance with practical requirements.

p.t: Water-Enhanced Direct Air Capture of Carbon Dioxide in Metal–Organic Frameworks
p.d: 研究水如何促进 MOF 对空气中低浓度 CO₂ 的捕集，关注湿度与碳捕集之间的协同作用。
p.e: Studies how water enhances MOF capture of dilute CO₂ from air, focusing on the synergy between humidity and carbon capture.

p.s: 末端 Zn–H 捕集位点
p.t: High-temperature carbon dioxide capture in a porous material with terminal zinc hydride sites
p.d: 探索具有末端锌氢位点的多孔材料用于高温 CO₂ 捕集，研究特定位点化学与吸附功能的联系。
p.e: Explores porous materials with terminal zinc hydride sites for high-temperature CO₂ capture, linking specific site chemistry to adsorption function.

p.t: Multigas adsorption with single-site cooperativity in a metal–organic framework
p.d: 研究 MOF 中单个位点的协同性与多种气体吸附之间的关系，探索不同于独立吸附位点的吸附行为。
p.e: Studies how cooperativity at individual sites in MOFs relates to the adsorption of several gases, exploring behaviour unlike independent adsorption sites.

p.t: Sequential ethane filling induced structural transitions in a flexible–robust metal–organic framework for ethylene purification
p.d: 研究乙烷逐步填充诱导的框架转变，并探索这种吸附与结构耦合如何用于乙烯纯化。
p.e: Studies a framework transition induced by stepwise ethane filling and explores how this coupling of adsorption and structure can be used to purify ethylene.

p.t: Eliminating lattice defects in metal–organic framework molecular-sieving membranes
p.d: 研究消除 MOF 分子筛膜中晶格缺陷的方法，关注缺陷形成的非选择性通道对分离的影响。
p.e: Studies how to eliminate lattice defects in MOF molecular-sieve membranes, focusing on the impact of non-selective defect channels on separation.

p.t: Metal-organic framework membranes with scale-like structure for efficient propylene/propane separation
p.d: 设计具有鳞片状结构的 MOF 膜用于丙烯／丙烷分离，将膜的结构组织作为分离性能的调控因素。
p.e: Designs MOF membranes with a scale-like architecture for propylene/propane separation, using membrane organisation as a lever on separation performance.

p.m: Angewandte Chemie International Edition 2024 · 膜与模块实验
p.t: Large-Area Ultrathin Metal–Organic Framework Membranes Fabricated on Flexible Polymer Supports for Gas Separations
p.d: 研究在柔性聚合物支撑上制备大面积超薄 MOF 膜，面向气体分离膜的尺度扩展与器件集成。
p.e: Prepares large-area ultrathin MOF membranes on flexible polymer supports, aiming at scale-up and device integration of gas separation membranes.

p.t: Scalable metal-organic framework membranes through nonclassical crystallization for molecular separation
p.d: 探索通过非经典结晶路线制备可规模化的 MOF 膜，研究膜形成过程与分子分离功能之间的联系。
p.e: Explores scalable MOF membranes made through non-classical crystallisation, linking membrane formation with molecular separation function.

p.t: Environmentally adaptive MOF-based device enables continuous self-optimizing atmospheric water harvesting
p.d: 研究能够随环境变化调整运行的 MOF 空气取水器件，关注材料吸水特性与器件操作的协调。
p.e: Studies a MOF water harvester whose operation adapts to environmental changes, coordinating the material's water uptake with device operation.

p.m: Nature Water 2023 · 户外器件实验
p.t: MOF water harvester produces water from Death Valley desert air in ambient sunlight
p.d: 在死亡谷沙漠环境中验证利用环境阳光运行的 MOF 空气取水器，考察实验室材料如何转化为户外取水系统。
p.e: Validates a MOF water harvester running on ambient sunlight in the Death Valley desert, testing how a laboratory material becomes an outdoor water-harvesting system.

p.m: Nature Communications 2024 · 材料＋户外器件
p.t: Time-efficient atmospheric water harvesting using Fluorophenyl oligomer incorporated MOFs
p.d: 研究引入氟苯基低聚物的 MOF 用于空气取水，关注缩短吸水与释水循环所需的时间。
p.e: Studies MOFs incorporating fluorophenyl oligomers for atmospheric water harvesting, focusing on shortening the uptake and release cycle.

p.t: A robust pyrazolate metal–organic framework for integrated perfluorooctanoic acid concentration and degradation
p.d: 利用稳定的吡唑盐 MOF 联合开展全氟辛酸的浓缩与降解，探索把污染物捕集和后续处理结合起来。
p.e: Uses a stable pyrazolate MOF to concentrate and then degrade perfluorooctanoic acid, combining pollutant capture with subsequent treatment.

p.t: Trace Adsorptive Removal of PFAS from Water by Optimizing the UiO-66 MOF Interface
p.d: 通过调节 UiO-66 的界面研究水中痕量 PFAS 的吸附去除，关注材料界面与污染物相互作用。
p.e: Studies adsorptive removal of trace PFAS from water by tuning UiO-66 interfaces, focusing on interactions between material interfaces and pollutants.

p.t: Balancing volumetric and gravimetric uptake in highly porous materials for clean energy
p.d: 研究高孔隙材料在单位质量与单位体积储气量之间的权衡，面向清洁能源气体的储存需求。
p.e: Studies the trade-off between gravimetric and volumetric gas storage in highly porous materials, targeting storage of clean-energy gases.

p.m: Nature Synthesis 2026 · 实验＋结构分析
p.t: Hierarchically porous metal–organic frameworks with red topology for hydrogen and methane storage
p.d: 探索具有 red 拓扑和分级孔隙的 MOF 用于氢气、甲烷储存，研究网络与孔结构的储气作用。
p.e: Explores a MOF with red topology and hierarchical pores for hydrogen and methane storage, studying how network and pore structure contribute to storage.

p.s: MOF 内单 Pt 位点
p.t: A one-pot strategy for anchoring single Pt atoms in MOFs with diverse coordination environments
p.d: 研究通过一锅法将单个铂原子锚定在 MOF 中，并调节其配位环境，面向原子级催化位点设计。
p.e: Studies one-pot anchoring of single platinum atoms in MOFs and tuning of their coordination environment, toward atomic-level design of catalytic sites.

p.m: Nature Communications 2024 · 材料＋电解器实验
p.t: An acid-tolerant metal-organic framework for industrial CO2 electrolysis using a proton exchange membrane
p.d: 研究耐酸 MOF 在质子交换膜 CO₂ 电解器中的应用，关注催化材料与工业电解环境的兼容性。
p.e: Studies an acid-stable MOF in a proton-exchange-membrane CO₂ electrolyser, focusing on compatibility between catalytic materials and industrial electrolysis conditions.

p.t: Reticular copper dual sites embedded with semiconductor particles for selective CO2-to-C2H4 photoreduction
p.d: 将网状化学构筑的铜双位点与半导体颗粒结合，探索选择性光还原 CO₂ 制乙烯的催化体系。
p.e: Combines reticular copper dual sites with semiconductor particles, exploring a catalytic system for selective photoreduction of CO₂ to ethylene.

p.m: Nature Communications 2025 · 实验＋工作态表征
p.t: In-situ restructuring of Ni-based metal organic frameworks for photocatalytic CO2 hydrogenation
p.d: 研究镍基 MOF 在光催化 CO₂ 加氢过程中的原位重构，关注反应时真实活性结构如何形成。
p.e: Studies in situ reconstruction of a nickel MOF during photocatalytic CO₂ hydrogenation, focusing on how the real active structure forms under reaction.

p.t: Experimental manifestation of redox-conductivity in metal-organic frameworks and its implication for semiconductor/insulator switching
p.d: 研究 MOF 中氧化还原状态与电导之间的联系，探索半导体／绝缘体切换的化学调控。
p.e: Studies the link between redox state and electrical conductivity in MOFs, exploring chemical control of semiconductor/insulator switching.

p.t: Atmospheric modulation of apparent electrical conductivity in a metal−organic framework
p.d: 研究周围气氛如何改变 MOF 的表观电导率，提醒导电性质的评价需要考虑测量环境。
p.e: Studies how the surrounding atmosphere changes the apparent conductivity of MOFs, a reminder that conductivity measurements must account for the environment.

p.t: Programming semiconducting two-dimensional conjugated metal–organic frameworks via anisotropic reticular chemistry
p.d: 利用各向异性网状化学设计二维共轭半导体 MOF，探索方向性结构设计与电子功能之间的联系。
p.e: Designs two-dimensional conjugated semiconducting MOFs with anisotropic reticular chemistry, linking directional structural design to electronic function.

p.t: Ultra-fast Proton Conduction and Photocatalytic Water Splitting in a Pillared Metal–Organic Framework
p.d: 研究柱撑 MOF 的快速质子传导与光催化分解水功能，关注框架内传输和反应过程的结合。
p.e: Studies fast proton conduction and photocatalytic water splitting in a pillared MOF, combining transport and reaction within the framework.

p.t: Mixed Ionic and Electronic Conductivity in a Tetrathiafulvalene-Phosphonate Metal–Organic Framework
p.d: 研究四硫富瓦烯膦酸盐 MOF 中的离子与电子混合导电，探索同一框架支持不同载流子的方式。
p.e: Studies mixed ionic and electronic conduction in a tetrathiafulvalene phosphonate MOF, exploring how one framework supports different charge carriers.

p.t: Isotopological entanglement of a metal–organic framework and a hydrogen-bonded organic framework for proton conduction
p.d: 将金属有机框架与氢键有机框架以同拓扑缠结方式结合，研究复合网络的质子传导。
p.e: Combines a metal–organic framework and a hydrogen-bonded organic framework through isoreticular interpenetration, studying proton conduction in the composite network.

p.m: Chemistry of Materials 2024 · 原位实验
p.t: The Mechanism of Rapid and Green Metal–Organic Framework Synthesis by In Situ Spectroscopy and Diffraction
p.d: 利用原位光谱和衍射研究快速、绿色 MOF 合成的形成机制，关注合成过程中的中间变化。
p.e: Uses in situ spectroscopy and diffraction to study how fast, green MOF syntheses proceed, focusing on intermediate changes during synthesis.

p.t: Room temperature photochemical synthesis of metal–organic frameworks for enhanced photocatalysis
p.d: 探索室温光化学路线制备 MOF，并研究其光催化功能，将合成条件与应用表现联系起来。
p.e: Explores room-temperature photochemical routes to MOFs and studies their photocatalytic function, linking synthesis conditions with application performance.

p.t: Sustainable supercritical-mechanochemical process
p.d: 研究超临界条件与机械化学相结合的可持续工艺，探索通过改变加工方式实现材料制备。
p.e: Studies a sustainable process combining supercritical conditions with mechanochemistry, exploring materials preparation through a different processing route.

p.m: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces 2022 · 成型实验
p.t: Meniscus-Guided 3D Microprinting of Pure Metal–Organic Frameworks with High Gas-Uptake Performance
p.d: 利用弯月面引导的三维微打印构筑纯 MOF 结构，研究微尺度成型与气体吸附功能的结合。
p.e: Builds pure MOF structures by meniscus-guided 3D microprinting, combining microscale shaping with gas adsorption function.

p.t: Understanding Metal–Organic Framework Densification: Solvent Effects and the Growth of Colloidal Primary Nanoparticles in Monolithic ZIF-8
p.d: 研究溶剂和胶体初级粒子生长对单块 ZIF-8 致密化的影响，关注粉体向整体材料转变的过程。
p.e: Studies how solvents and the growth of colloidal primary particles affect densification of monolithic ZIF-8, following the transition from powder to monolith.

p.t: Uniform single-crystal mesoporous metal–organic frameworks
p.d: 研究具有均匀介孔的单晶 MOF，将更大尺度孔隙引入有序框架，探索孔结构的分级设计。
p.e: Studies single-crystal MOFs with uniform mesopores, introducing larger pores into ordered frameworks to explore hierarchical pore design.

p.m: Chemical Engineering Journal 2023 · 工艺模拟＋实验
p.t: CO2/N2 separation by vacuum swing adsorption using a metal–organic framework, CALF-20: Multi-objective optimization and experimental validation
p.d: 对使用 CALF-20 的 CO₂／N₂ 真空变压吸附过程开展多目标优化和实验验证，连接吸附材料与运行工艺。
p.e: Performs multi-objective optimisation and experimental validation of CO₂/N₂ vacuum swing adsorption with CALF-20, linking the adsorbent to process operation.

p.m: Nature 2024 · 计算平台＋案例验证
p.t: A holistic platform for accelerating sorbent-based carbon capture
p.d: 构建加速吸附剂碳捕集研发的综合平台，关注从材料选择到工艺与应用评价的整体联系。
p.e: Builds an integrated platform to accelerate adsorbent development for carbon capture, connecting material selection with process and application evaluation.

p.m: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces 2024 · 配位表征与吸附机制
p.t: Local Coordination Environment of Lanthanides Adsorbed onto Cr- and Zr-based Metal–Organic Frameworks
p.d: 研究 Nd、Gd、Lu 在 Cr-MIL-101、UiO-66、UiO-68 及其衍生物中的局部配位环境，区分金属氧簇、缺陷与膦酸基团的吸附作用。重点理解哪些位点真正结合稀土，以及官能化如何改变位点竞争。
p.e: Studies the local coordination environment of Nd, Gd and Lu in Cr-MIL-101, UiO-66, UiO-68 and their derivatives, distinguishing adsorption at metal-oxo clusters, defects and phosphonate groups. The focus is on which sites actually bind rare earths and how functionalisation changes competition between sites.

p.m: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces 2026 · 配体负载、吸附与再生
p.t: Aqueous Adsorption of Rare Earth Elements by Organophosphonate-Ligand-Modified Metal–Organic Frameworks: The Role of Ligand Loading in Surface Complexation
p.d: 在 MIL-101 中改变 PMIDA 配体负载量，结合吸附实验与分子动力学研究 Nd、Gd、Dy 的络合及 Fe(III) 竞争。更高负载会增强配位，却不带来成比例的容量提升，并揭示强结合与酸洗再生之间的权衡。
p.e: Varies PMIDA ligand loading in MIL-101 and combines adsorption experiments with molecular dynamics to study complexation of Nd, Gd and Dy and competition from Fe(III). Higher loading strengthens coordination without a proportional gain in capacity, revealing a trade-off between strong binding and acid-wash regeneration.

p.m: Nature Communications 2024 · MOF 轻重稀土分离
p.t: Rationally designed nanotrap structures for efficient separation of rare earth elements over a single step
p.d: 利用 NCU-1 中未配位羧基、三唑氮和互穿形成的纳米口袋，研究局部几何与轻稀土优先吸附的关系。通过六组二元离子对和真实尾矿进料验证分离表现；区分分离因子、容量与实际产品纯度。
p.e: Combines uncoordinated carboxyl groups, triazole nitrogens and interpenetration-defined pockets in NCU-1 to study how local geometry favours light rare-earth adsorption. Six binary ion pairs and real tailings feeds test separation performance, while separation factors, capacity and actual product purity remain distinct metrics.

p.m: Advanced Functional Materials 2025 · 稀土离子交换与选择性分离
p.t: Efficient Separation of Adjacent Rare Earths in One Step by Using Ion-microporous Metal–Organic Frameworks
p.d: 在离子微孔 MOF ATZ-BTC-Zn 中结合纳米捕获口袋、离子传输通道和可交换反离子，研究稀土离子的选择性捕获与分离。阅读时需逐一核对所测离子对，区分相邻元素与非相邻元素的证据。
p.e: Combines nanotrap pockets, ion-transport channels and exchangeable counter-ions in the ion-microporous MOF ATZ-BTC-Zn to study selective capture and separation of rare-earth ions. When reading, check each measured ion pair to tell evidence for adjacent elements from evidence for non-adjacent ones.

p.m: Nature 2023 · 非 MOF 对照：蛋白质识别与柱分离
p.t: Enhanced rare-earth separation with a metal-sensitive lanmodulin dimer
p.d: 研究镧系结合蛋白如何将微小离子尺寸差异放大为配位、氢键网络及二聚化差异，并用于 Nd/Dy 柱分离。作为非 MOF 对照，为柔性识别位点与协同性设计提供启发。
p.e: Studies how a lanthanide-binding protein amplifies tiny differences in ionic size into differences in coordination, hydrogen-bond networks and dimerisation, and uses this for Nd/Dy column separation. As a non-MOF benchmark, it offers ideas for designing flexible recognition sites and cooperativity.

p.m: ACS Central Science 2021 · 非 MOF 对照：复杂进料与分离工艺
p.t: Bridging Hydrometallurgy and Biochemistry: A Protein-Based Process for Recovery and Separation of Rare Earth Elements
p.d: 将镧系结合蛋白固定化用于稀土回收与柱分离，研究复杂进料中的捕集、分组和目标离子对分离。作为非 MOF 工艺对照，帮助区分高吸附亲和力与高纯度、高回收率分离之间的要求。
p.e: Immobilises a lanthanide-binding protein for rare-earth recovery and column separation, studying capture, grouping and separation of target ion pairs from complex feeds. As a non-MOF process benchmark, it helps distinguish high adsorption affinity from the demands of high-purity, high-recovery separation.

p.m: ICRA 2024 · 实机数据＋跨身体学习
p.t: Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models
p.d: 汇集不同机器人的操作数据并研究跨机器人学习，让通用策略能够利用不同身体和任务中积累的经验。
p.e: Pools manipulation data from many robots and studies cross-embodiment learning, so a generalist policy can draw on experience accumulated across different bodies and tasks.

p.t: DROID: A Large-Scale In-The-Wild Robot Manipulation Dataset
p.d: 构建大规模真实环境机器人操作数据集，关注多样场景中的示教数据如何支持操作策略学习。
p.e: Builds a large real-world robot manipulation dataset, examining how demonstrations from diverse scenes support manipulation policy learning.

p.m: RSS 2024 · 手持示教＋实机策略
p.t: Universal Manipulation Interface: In-The-Wild Robot Teaching Without In-The-Wild Robots
p.d: 利用可手持的示教接口收集操作经验，探索在采集现场无需部署机器人的情况下为机器人学习提供数据。
p.e: Collects manipulation experience with a handheld demonstration interface, providing data for robot learning without deploying a robot at the collection site.

p.m: CoRL 2022 · 视频预训练＋仿真/实机
p.t: R3M: A Universal Visual Representation for Robot Manipulation
p.d: 研究可复用于机器人操作的视觉表示，使视觉预训练获得的信息能够支持后续控制任务。
p.e: Studies visual representations reusable for robot manipulation, so information from visual pretraining can support downstream control.

p.m: NeurIPS 2023 · 表示学习＋跨任务评测
p.t: Where are we in the search for an Artificial Visual Cortex for Embodied Intelligence?
p.d: 研究面向具身智能的通用视觉表征，并通过跨任务评测考察同一视觉模型对不同控制任务的适用性。
p.e: Studies general visual representations for embodied AI and uses cross-task evaluation to test how well one visual model serves different control tasks.

p.t: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
p.d: 将视觉语言模型与机器人动作结合，研究如何把网络数据中获得的语义知识迁移到机器人控制。
p.e: Combines vision-language models with robot actions, studying how semantic knowledge from web data transfers to robot control.

p.m: RSS 2024 · 通用策略＋实机迁移
p.t: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
p.d: 构建开源通用机器人策略，探索利用多样操作数据训练能够迁移到不同机器人任务的模型。
p.e: Builds an open-source generalist robot policy trained on diverse manipulation data that can transfer to different robot tasks.

p.t: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
p.d: 构建开源视觉—语言—动作模型，研究如何将图像观测与语言指令转化为机器人控制动作。
p.e: Builds an open-source vision–language–action model, studying how image observations and language instructions become robot control actions.

p.t: π₀: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
p.d: 将视觉语言理解与流模型动作生成结合，探索面向多种机器人操作任务的通用控制模型。
p.e: Combines vision-language understanding with flow-based action generation, exploring a general control model for many robot manipulation tasks.

p.m: CoRL 2025 · 异构共训＋真实新场景
p.t: π₀.₅: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization
p.d: 研究视觉—语言—动作模型在开放环境中的泛化，关注机器人面对新场景时能否继续完成任务。
p.e: Studies how vision–language–action models generalise in open environments, asking whether robots can still complete tasks in new scenes.

p.t: LAP: Language-Action Pre-training Enables Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Transfer
p.d: 研究语言—动作预训练能否支持零样本跨机器人迁移，关注已有技能如何适用于不同身体。
p.e: Studies whether language–action pretraining supports zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer, focusing on how existing skills apply to different bodies.

p.t: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
p.d: 把机器人动作序列的生成写成条件去噪过程，根据视觉观测逐步生成动作，并结合滚动执行处理操作任务。
p.e: Frames generation of robot action sequences as conditional denoising, generating actions step by step from visual observations and using receding-horizon execution for manipulation.

p.m: RSS 2023 · 双臂实机＋模仿学习
p.t: Learning Fine-Grained Bimanual Manipulation with Low-Cost Hardware
p.d: 研究利用低成本双臂硬件与示教学习完成精细操作，将动作序列学习与可负担的机器人平台结合。
p.e: Studies fine manipulation with low-cost bimanual hardware and imitation learning, pairing action-sequence learning with an affordable robot platform.

p.m: CoRL 2025 · 生成策略与执行研究
p.t: Streaming Flow Policy: Simplifying diffusion/flow-matching policies by treating action trajectories as flow trajectories
p.d: 将动作轨迹作为流轨迹建模，探索更简洁的扩散／流匹配机器人策略与连续动作生成方式。
p.e: Models action trajectories as flow trajectories, exploring simpler diffusion / flow matching robot policies and continuous action generation.

p.t: Perceiver-Actor: A Multi-Task Transformer for Robotic Manipulation
p.d: 使用 Perceiver-Actor 架构开展多任务机器人操作学习，研究如何把感知表示转化为多种任务的动作。
p.e: Uses the Perceiver-Actor architecture for multi-task robot manipulation, studying how perceptual representations become actions for many tasks.

p.t: RVT: Robotic View Transformer for 3D Object Manipulation
p.d: 利用视觉 Transformer 研究三维物体操作，关注机器人如何从场景观测提取可用于动作决策的空间信息。
p.e: Uses vision Transformers for 3D object manipulation, focusing on how a robot extracts spatial information for action decisions from scene observations.

p.t: 3D Diffusion Policy: Generalizable Visuomotor Policy Learning via Simple 3D Representations
p.d: 将简单三维表示与扩散策略结合，研究如何利用空间几何提高视觉运动策略在不同场景中的适用性。
p.e: Combines simple 3D representations with diffusion policies, studying how spatial geometry makes visuomotor policies work across more scenes.

p.t: Contact-Anchored Policies: Contact Conditioning Creates Strong Robot Utility Models
p.d: 将接触信息作为策略条件，研究明确的接触约束或线索如何支持机器人操作行为的学习。
p.e: Conditions policies on contact information, studying how explicit contact constraints or cues support learning manipulation behaviour.

p.t: AnyTeleop: A General Vision-Based Dexterous Robot Arm-Hand Teleoperation System
p.d: 构建基于视觉的通用机械臂—灵巧手遥操作系统，研究如何将人类动作映射为机器人示教。
p.e: Builds a general vision-based teleoperation system for arm–dexterous-hand robots, studying how human motion maps to robot demonstrations.

p.m: RSS 2024 · 便携动捕＋实机模仿
p.t: DexCap: Scalable and Portable Mocap Data Collection System for Dexterous Manipulation
p.d: 构建可携带、可扩展的灵巧操作动捕数据采集系统，关注细致的人手操作经验如何用于机器人学习。
p.e: Builds a portable, scalable motion-capture system for dexterous manipulation data, studying how detailed human hand experience can be used for robot learning.

p.m: CoRL 2022 · 语言规划＋实机技能
p.t: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
p.d: 结合语言模型的任务判断与机器人技能的可执行性，选择既符合用户目标又能在当前环境完成的动作。
p.e: Combines a language model's task judgement with the feasibility of robot skills, choosing actions that match the user's goal and can be done in the current environment.

p.m: ICRA 2023 · 程序生成＋机器人实验
p.t: Code as Policies: Language Model Programs for Embodied Control
p.d: 让语言模型生成调用感知与控制接口的程序，将语言指令转化为可执行的机器人控制逻辑。
p.e: Has language models write programs that call perception and control APIs, turning language instructions into executable robot control logic.

p.m: ICML 2023 · 多模态模型＋机器人任务
p.t: PaLM-E: An Embodied Multimodal Language Model
p.d: 将具身感知信息融入多模态语言模型，研究模型如何结合语言与环境观测处理机器人任务。
p.e: Integrates embodied sensory information into a multimodal language model, studying how it combines language and environment observations for robot tasks.

p.t: VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models
p.d: 利用语言模型构建可组合的三维价值图，将文字目标转化为空间中的操作引导。
p.e: Uses language models to build composable 3D value maps, turning textual goals into spatial guidance for manipulation.

p.t: ReKep: Spatio-Temporal Reasoning of Relational Keypoint Constraints for Robotic Manipulation
p.d: 将操作任务表达为关键点之间的时空关系约束，研究通过约束推理指导机器人完成多步骤操作。
p.e: Expresses manipulation tasks as spatio-temporal constraints between keypoints, studying how constraint reasoning guides robots through multi-step manipulation.

p.t: Inner Monologue: Embodied Reasoning through Planning with Language Models
p.d: 把环境反馈引入语言模型的规划循环，让机器人在执行过程中根据观察更新后续计划。
p.e: Brings environment feedback into a language model's planning loop, letting a robot update its plan from observations during execution.

p.m: CoRL 2023 · 多传感经历＋失败纠正
p.t: REFLECT: Summarizing Robot Experiences for Failure Explanation and Correction
p.d: 将机器人的多传感经历整理为任务回顾，研究如何解释失败并据此纠正后续执行。
p.e: Summarises a robot's multisensory experience into a task review, studying how to explain failures and correct later execution.

p.m: Science Robotics 2023 · 数学方法＋运动规划实验
p.t: Motion Planning around Obstacles with Convex Optimization
p.d: 通过凸优化研究绕障运动规划，把环境中的可行区域与路径选择结合起来求解。
p.e: Studies motion planning around obstacles through convex optimization, solving jointly over the feasible regions of the environment and the choice of path.

p.m: 技术报告 / arXiv 2023 · 并行规划系统
p.t: cuRobo: Parallelized Collision-Free Minimum-Jerk Robot Motion Generation
p.d: 研究并行化的无碰撞、最小急动度运动生成，面向机器人路径规划与平滑轨迹求解。
p.e: Studies parallelised collision-free, minimum-jerk motion generation for robot path planning and smooth trajectory optimisation.

p.m: RSS 2023 · 真实场景地图＋任务评测
p.t: ConceptFusion: Open-set Multimodal 3D Mapping
p.d: 构建开放集合的多模态三维地图，研究如何让空间地图保存可由不同语义提示检索的信息。
p.e: Builds open-set multimodal 3D maps, studying how spatial maps can store information retrievable by different semantic prompts.

p.m: ICRA 2024 · 真实场景图＋规划应用
p.t: ConceptGraphs: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs for Perception and Planning
p.d: 将三维场景组织为开放词汇场景图，用物体及其关系连接机器人感知与任务规划。
p.e: Organises 3D scenes as open-vocabulary scene graphs, connecting robot perception and task planning through objects and their relations.

p.m: CoRL 2023 · 多数据预训练＋实机导航
p.t: ViNT: A Foundation Model for Visual Navigation
p.d: 构建视觉导航基础模型，研究如何通过多样导航经验学习可迁移的视觉运动能力。
p.e: Builds a visual navigation foundation model, studying how transferable visuomotor skills can be learned from diverse navigation experience.

p.t: NoMaD: Goal Masked Diffusion Policies for Navigation and Exploration
p.d: 将目标掩码与扩散策略用于导航和探索，研究机器人在有目标与未知环境探索之间的动作生成。
p.e: Uses goal masking and diffusion policies for navigation and exploration, generating actions for both goal-directed travel and exploring unknown environments.

p.m: RSS 2025 · 层级导航＋足式实机
p.t: NaVILA: Legged Robot Vision-Language-Action Model for Navigation
p.d: 将视觉、语言和动作模型用于足式机器人导航，连接语言目标、场景理解与行走决策。
p.e: Applies vision–language–action models to legged-robot navigation, connecting language goals, scene understanding and locomotion decisions.

p.m: NeurIPS 2021 · 视觉 SLAM 数据集评测
p.t: DROID-SLAM: Deep Visual SLAM for Monocular, Stereo, and RGB-D Cameras
p.d: 用深度学习研究单目、双目和 RGB-D 视觉 SLAM，联合处理相机运动估计与场景几何恢复。
p.e: Applies deep learning to monocular, stereo and RGB-D visual SLAM, jointly estimating camera motion and recovering scene geometry.

p.t: SplaTAM: Splat, Track & Map 3D Gaussians for Dense RGB-D SLAM
p.d: 使用三维高斯表示开展 RGB-D 跟踪与稠密建图，将相机定位和场景重建结合起来。
p.e: Uses 3D Gaussian representations for RGB-D tracking and dense mapping, combining camera localisation with scene reconstruction.

p.m: Science Robotics 2022 · 仿真训练＋野外实机
p.t: Learning robust perceptive locomotion for quadrupedal robots in the wild
p.d: 研究四足机器人在野外环境中的感知驱动运动，让地形观测参与复杂路面的行走控制。
p.e: Studies perception-driven locomotion for quadrupeds in the wild, bringing terrain observations into walking control on difficult ground.

p.m: ICRA 2024 · 仿真训练＋四足实机
p.t: Extreme Parkour with Legged Robots
p.d: 研究足式机器人完成复杂跑酷动作的控制策略，关注障碍环境中的感知、运动规划与身体协调。
p.e: Studies control policies that let legged robots perform complex parkour, focusing on perception, motion planning and body coordination among obstacles.

p.m: IROS 2024 · 仿真训练＋人形遥操作
p.t: Learning Human-to-Humanoid Real-Time Whole-Body Teleoperation
p.d: 研究人类到人形机器人的实时全身遥操作，将人的动作转换为机器人的协调运动。
p.e: Studies real-time whole-body teleoperation from humans to humanoid robots, converting human movement into coordinated robot motion.

p.m: CoRL 2024 · 遥操作采集＋实机自主模仿
p.t: HumanPlus: Humanoid Shadowing and Imitation from Humans
p.d: 让人形机器人跟随并模仿人类动作，研究如何通过人类示范学习全身行为与操作技能。
p.e: Has humanoid robots shadow and imitate human motion, studying how whole-body behaviours and manipulation skills can be learned from human demonstrations.

p.m: RSS 2025 · 仿真校正＋人形实机
p.t: ASAP: Aligning Simulation and Real-World Physics for Learning Agile Humanoid Whole-Body Skills
p.d: 研究对齐仿真与真实物理的方法，帮助在模拟环境学习的人形敏捷全身动作迁移到实机。
p.e: Studies how to align simulation with real-world physics, helping agile humanoid whole-body motions learned in simulation transfer to real robots.

p.t: Mobile ALOHA: Learning Bimanual Mobile Manipulation using Low-Cost Whole-Body Teleoperation
p.d: 通过低成本全身遥操作学习双臂移动操作，研究底盘移动与双臂动作之间的协调。
p.e: Learns bimanual mobile manipulation through low-cost whole-body teleoperation, studying coordination between base motion and two-arm actions.

p.m: ICRA 2024 · 仿真训练＋四足实机
p.t: Pedipulate: Enabling Manipulation Skills using a Quadruped Robot’s Leg
p.d: 探索让四足机器人使用腿完成操作任务，研究同一身体部件兼顾移动与物体操作的可能性。
p.e: Explores letting quadrupeds use their legs for manipulation, studying whether the same limb can serve both locomotion and object handling.

p.m: ICLR 2024 · 生成模拟＋实机迁移实验
p.t: Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators
p.d: 研究从数据中学习可交互的真实世界模拟器，探索用生成式环境模型支持交互与任务学习。
p.e: Studies learning interactive real-world simulators from data, exploring generative environment models that support interaction and task learning.

p.m: ICLR 2024 · 多类仿真控制任务
p.t: TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control
p.d: 研究可扩展、鲁棒的连续控制世界模型，将环境动态建模与动作规划结合起来。
p.e: Studies scalable, robust world models for continuous control, combining dynamics modelling with action planning.

p.m: Nature 2025 · 虚拟环境与控制基准
p.t: Mastering diverse control tasks through world models
p.d: 研究通过世界模型学习多样控制任务，让智能体利用内部预测进行行为学习。
p.e: Studies learning diverse control tasks through world models, letting agents learn behaviour from their internal predictions.

p.m: RSS 2024 · 真实扫描→仿真 RL→实机
p.t: Reconciling Reality through Simulation: A Real-To-Sim-to-Real Approach for Robust Manipulation
p.d: 将真实场景转换为仿真环境，再把仿真中学习的策略迁回真实环境，面向更鲁棒的机器人操作。
p.e: Converts real scenes into simulation and transfers policies learned there back to the real world, toward more robust robot manipulation.

p.m: CoRL 2024 · 生成图像训练＋四足实机
p.t: Learning Visual Parkour from Generated Images
p.d: 利用生成图像训练视觉跑酷策略，探索如何用合成视觉经验支持机器人在真实环境中运动。
p.e: Trains visual parkour policies on generated images, exploring how synthetic visual experience supports robot locomotion in the real world.

p.m: RSS 2026 · 控制接口与迁移实验
p.t: Tune to Learn: How Controller Gains Shape Robot Policy Learning
p.d: 研究底层控制器增益如何影响机器人策略学习，关注控制接口的设置与上层学习之间的耦合。
p.e: Studies how low-level controller gains affect robot policy learning, focusing on the coupling between control-interface settings and higher-level learning.

p.t: ManiSkill2: A Unified Benchmark for Generalizable Manipulation Skills
p.d: 构建面向可泛化操作技能的统一仿真基准，用于训练与比较不同机器人操作方法。
p.e: Builds a unified simulation benchmark for generalisable manipulation skills, for training and comparing robot manipulation methods.

p.m: RSS 2024 · 家庭任务仿真平台
p.t: RoboCasa: Large-Scale Simulation of Household Tasks for Generalist Robots
p.d: 构建大规模家庭任务仿真环境，研究通用机器人在多样家居场景中的学习与评测。
p.e: Builds a large household-task simulation environment, studying how generalist robots learn and are evaluated in diverse home scenes.

p.m: CoRL 2022 · 日常活动仿真基准
p.t: BEHAVIOR-1K: A Benchmark for Embodied AI with 1,000 Everyday Activities and Realistic Simulation
p.d: 提供包含千种日常活动的具身智能仿真基准，关注贴近生活的长任务与真实物理交互。
p.e: Provides an embodied-AI simulation benchmark of a thousand everyday activities, focusing on realistic long-horizon tasks and physical interaction.

p.m: CoRL 2024 · 真实触觉数据＋下游评测
p.t: Sparsh: Self-supervised touch representations for vision-based tactile sensing
p.d: 通过自监督学习建立视觉触觉表示，将触觉传感器图像转换为可用于下游任务的特征。
p.e: Builds visuo-tactile representations with self-supervised learning, turning tactile sensor images into features for downstream tasks.

p.m: ICLR 2025 · 多传感触觉＋实机任务
p.t: Learning Unified Static-Dynamic Representation across Multiple Visuo-tactile Sensors
p.d: 研究跨多种视觉触觉传感器的统一静态与动态表示，关注不同传感器之间的触觉经验共享。
p.e: Studies unified static and dynamic representations across many visuo-tactile sensors, focusing on sharing tactile experience between sensors.

p.m: RSS 2025 · 视觉触觉/力闭环操作
p.t: Reactive Diffusion Policy: Slow-Fast Visual-Tactile Policy Learning for Contact-Rich Manipulation
p.d: 将慢速视觉决策与快速触觉反馈结合到扩散策略中，面向需要持续接触调整的操作任务。
p.e: Combines slow visual decisions with fast tactile feedback in a diffusion policy, for manipulation tasks that need continual contact adjustment.

p.t: To the Noise and Back: Diffusion for Shared Autonomy
p.d: 将扩散模型用于共享自主控制，研究机器人如何把用户输入与自主动作生成结合起来。
p.e: Uses diffusion models for shared autonomy, studying how a robot combines user input with autonomous action generation.

p.m: RSS 2024 · 语言纠正＋实机长任务
p.t: Yell At Your Robot: Improving On-the-Fly from Language Corrections
p.d: 研究机器人执行时如何利用语言纠正即时改进行为，让用户反馈进入在线操作过程。
p.e: Studies how robots can use verbal corrections to improve behaviour on the fly, bringing user feedback into online manipulation.

p.m: CoRL 2023 · 模块化软体机器人仿真
p.t: PreCo: Enhancing Generalization in Co-Design of Modular Soft Robots via Brain-Body Pre-Training
p.d: 通过身体与控制策略的预训练研究模块化软体机器人协同设计，关注新形态上的泛化能力。
p.e: Studies co-design of modular soft robots by pretraining bodies and control policies, focusing on generalisation to new morphologies.

p.m: NeurIPS 2023 · 物理生成＋模拟/制造示例
p.t: DiffuseBot: Breeding Soft Robots With Physics-Augmented Generative Diffusion Models
p.d: 把物理信息融入扩散生成过程来设计软体机器人，研究生成的身体形态与运动功能之间的联系。
p.e: Designs soft robots by bringing physics into the diffusion generation process, studying the link between generated body shapes and locomotion function.

p.m: PNAS 2023 · 可微设计＋实体软体实验
p.t: Efficient automatic design of robots
p.d: 研究高效自动设计机器人形态的方法，探索如何将任务需求转化为可制造的机器人身体。
p.e: Studies efficient methods for automatic robot morphology design, exploring how task requirements become manufacturable robot bodies.

p.m: NeurIPS 2023 · 仿真终身学习基准
p.t: LIBERO: Benchmarking Knowledge Transfer for Lifelong Robot Learning
p.d: 构建终身机器人学习中的知识迁移基准，研究机器人学习新任务时如何复用已有技能。
p.e: Builds a benchmark for knowledge transfer in lifelong robot learning, studying how robots reuse existing skills when learning new tasks.

p.m: CoRL 2024 · 仿真与配对实机评测
p.t: Evaluating Real-World Robot Manipulation Policies in Simulation
p.d: 研究在仿真中评估真实机器人操作策略的方法，关注模拟测试与实机表现之间的对应关系。
p.e: Studies evaluating real-robot manipulation policies in simulation, focusing on how simulated tests correspond to real-robot performance.

p.m: RSS 2026 · 实景重建＋配对实机评测
p.t: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
p.d: 研究可扩展的真实到仿真评测流程，面向通用机器人策略在真实场景对应模拟环境中的测试。
p.e: Studies a scalable real-to-sim evaluation pipeline for testing generalist robot policies in simulated counterparts of real scenes.

p.m: CoRL 2023 · 理论＋仿真/实机求助
p.t: Robots That Ask For Help: Uncertainty Alignment for Large Language Model Planners
p.d: 研究语言模型规划中的不确定性与求助机制，让机器人识别需要向人类询问的任务情况。
p.e: Studies uncertainty and help-seeking in language-model planning, letting robots recognise when they should ask a human.

p.m: ICLR 2025 · 理论＋规划/控制任务
p.t: SafeDiffuser: Safe Planning with Diffusion Probabilistic Models
p.d: 将安全规划与扩散概率模型结合，研究如何在动作生成中纳入安全要求。
p.e: Combines safe planning with diffusion probabilistic models, studying how to incorporate safety requirements into action generation.

p.m: CoRL 2025 · 仿真＋实机数据/四旋翼
p.t: Real-Time Out-of-Distribution Failure Prevention via Multi-Modal Reasoning
p.d: 利用多模态推理研究实时分布外故障预防，关注机器人遇到不熟悉情形时如何识别潜在失败。
p.e: Uses multimodal reasoning for real-time prevention of out-of-distribution failures, focusing on how robots recognise potential failure in unfamiliar situations.

p.m: ICRA 2021 · 分散规划＋无人机实机
p.t: EGO-Swarm: A Fully Autonomous and Decentralized Quadrotor Swarm System in Cluttered Environments
p.d: 研究杂乱环境中的自主分散式四旋翼集群，关注多架无人机的协调运动与避障。
p.e: Studies autonomous decentralised quadrotor swarms in cluttered environments, focusing on coordinated motion and obstacle avoidance among many drones.

p.m: AAAI 2022 · 离散多智能体路径基准
p.t: MAPF-LNS2: Fast Repairing for Multi-Agent Path Finding via Large Neighborhood Search
p.d: 通过大邻域搜索修复多智能体路径方案，研究如何高效减少不同智能体之间的路径冲突。
p.e: Repairs multi-agent path plans with large neighbourhood search, studying how to reduce path conflicts between agents efficiently.

p.m: AAAI 2023 · 离散多智能体路径基准
p.t: LaCAM: Search-Based Algorithm for Quick Multi-Agent Pathfinding
p.d: 研究快速多智能体寻路的搜索算法，在多个智能体共享空间时寻找可协调执行的路径。
p.e: Studies search algorithms for fast multi-agent path finding, seeking paths that many agents sharing a space can execute together.

p.m: Physical Review Research 2020 · 较早入口
p.t: Ab initio solution of the many-electron Schrödinger equation with deep neural networks
p.d: 提出 FermiNet，用满足费米子反对称性的深度神经网络作为波函数，并通过变分蒙特卡洛优化，在小分子上达到接近高精度量子化学方法的能量。
p.e: Introduces FermiNet, a deep neural network wavefunction that respects fermionic antisymmetry and is optimised by variational Monte Carlo, reaching energies close to high-accuracy quantum chemistry methods on small molecules.

p.t: Deep-neural-network solution of the electronic Schrödinger equation
p.d: 提出 PauliNet，把 Hartree–Fock 轨道、Jastrow 因子和尖点条件等物理知识嵌入神经网络波函数，用较少参数获得高精度基态能量。
p.e: Introduces PauliNet, which embeds physical knowledge such as Hartree–Fock orbitals, a Jastrow factor and cusp conditions into a neural wavefunction, achieving accurate ground-state energies with relatively few parameters.

p.t: A Self-Attention Ansatz for Ab-initio Quantum Chemistry
p.d: 提出基于自注意力的神经网络波函数 Psiformer，相比 FermiNet 在较大分子上显著提升了精度，表明 Transformer 结构适合建模电子关联。
p.e: Introduces Psiformer, a self-attention neural wavefunction that clearly improves on FermiNet for larger molecules, showing that Transformer architectures suit modelling electron correlation.

p.t: Accurate computation of quantum excited states with neural networks
p.d: 提出把多个激发态视为一个扩展系统的基态来求解的变分方法，使神经网络波函数能准确计算分子的激发态能量与性质。
p.e: Proposes a variational method that treats several excited states as the ground state of an expanded system, letting neural wavefunctions compute molecular excited-state energies and properties accurately.

p.m: Physical Review Letters 2021 · 较早入口
p.t: Kohn-Sham Equations as Regularizer: Building Prior Knowledge into Machine-Learned Physics
p.d: 把可微的 Kohn–Sham 自洽迭代作为训练的一部分来学习交换关联泛函，物理求解过程起到正则作用，使模型用很少数据就能良好泛化。
p.e: Learns exchange-correlation functionals by making the differentiable Kohn–Sham self-consistent iteration part of training; the physics solver acts as a regulariser, so the model generalises well from very little data.

p.t: Pushing the frontiers of density functionals by solving the fractional electron problem
p.d: 训练神经网络交换关联泛函 DM21，并在数据中加入分数电荷和分数自旋体系，缓解了传统泛函的离域误差与静态关联误差。
p.e: Trains the neural exchange-correlation functional DM21 with fractional-charge and fractional-spin systems in the data, reducing the delocalisation and static-correlation errors of conventional functionals.

p.t: Quantum chemistry structures and properties of 134 kilo molecules
p.d: 发布约十三万个小有机分子的 DFT 优化结构和能量、偶极矩等量子化学性质，成为分子机器学习最常用的基准数据集之一。
p.e: Releases DFT-optimised structures and quantum-chemical properties such as energies and dipole moments for about 134,000 small organic molecules; one of the most widely used benchmarks in molecular machine learning.

p.t: Unifying machine learning and quantum chemistry with a deep neural network for molecular wavefunctions
p.d: 用深度网络预测分子在原子轨道基组下的哈密顿量和重叠矩阵，从而得到轨道能级和波函数，把机器学习与量子化学计算直接联系起来。
p.e: Uses a deep network to predict molecular Hamiltonian and overlap matrices in an atomic-orbital basis, yielding orbital energies and wavefunctions and linking machine learning directly to quantum chemistry.

p.m: The Journal of Chemical Physics 2020 · 已有扩展
p.t: OrbNet: Deep learning for quantum chemistry using symmetry-adapted atomic-orbital features
p.d: 用半经验量子化学计算得到的对称适配原子轨道特征构建图神经网络，以很低成本预测接近 DFT 精度的分子能量。
p.e: Builds a graph neural network on symmetry-adapted atomic-orbital features from semi-empirical quantum chemistry, predicting molecular energies near DFT accuracy at very low cost.

p.m: Nature Computational Science 2022 · 已有扩展
p.t: Deep-learning density functional theory Hamiltonian for efficient ab initio electronic-structure calculation
p.d: 利用电子结构的局域性和对称性，用深度网络预测材料的 DFT 哈密顿量，避免自洽迭代，可用于转角二维材料等大规模体系。
p.e: Exploits the locality and symmetry of electronic structure to predict the DFT Hamiltonian of materials with a deep network, avoiding self-consistent iteration and scaling to large systems such as twisted 2D materials.

p.m: Physical Review Letters 2007 · 较早入口
p.t: Generalized Neural-Network Representation of High-Dimensional Potential-Energy Surfaces
p.d: 提出把体系能量写成各原子能量之和、并用对称函数描述原子局域环境的神经网络势，奠定了高维机器学习势能面的基本框架。
p.e: Proposes neural network potentials that write the total energy as a sum of atomic energies and describe each atom's local environment with symmetry functions, establishing the basic framework for high-dimensional machine-learned potential energy surfaces.

p.m: Physical Review Letters 2010 · 较早入口
p.t: Gaussian Approximation Potentials: The Accuracy of Quantum Mechanics, without the Electrons
p.d: 提出高斯近似势，用高斯过程回归从量子力学数据中学习原子能量，以远低于 DFT 的成本获得接近量子力学的精度。
p.e: Proposes Gaussian approximation potentials, which learn atomic energies from quantum-mechanical data with Gaussian process regression, giving near-quantum accuracy at far lower cost than DFT.

p.t: SchNet: A continuous-filter convolutional neural network for modeling quantum interactions
p.d: 提出连续滤波卷积神经网络 SchNet，直接以原子类型和坐标为输入学习分子能量与力，避免了手工设计描述符。
p.e: Introduces SchNet, a continuous-filter convolutional network that learns molecular energies and forces directly from atom types and coordinates, without hand-crafted descriptors.

p.m: Physical Review Letters 2018 · 近年代表
p.t: Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics: A Scalable Model with the Accuracy of Quantum Mechanics
p.d: 提出深度势分子动力学方法，在保持对称性的同时以接近量子力学的精度进行大规模分子动力学模拟，后来成为广泛使用的开源框架。
p.e: Introduces Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics, which runs large-scale molecular dynamics at near-quantum accuracy while preserving symmetries, and later became a widely used open-source framework.

p.t: E(3)-equivariant graph neural networks for data-efficient and accurate interatomic potentials
p.d: 提出 E(3) 等变图神经网络势 NequIP，用等变张量特征表示原子环境，比不变模型所需训练数据少几个数量级仍能达到更高精度。
p.e: Introduces NequIP, an E(3)-equivariant graph neural network potential that represents atomic environments with equivariant tensor features and reaches higher accuracy with orders of magnitude less training data than invariant models.

p.t: MACE: Higher Order Equivariant Message Passing Neural Networks for Fast and Accurate Force Fields
p.d: 在等变消息传递中引入高阶多体消息，只需两层就能达到很高精度，兼顾了原子间势的准确性与计算速度。
p.e: Introduces higher-order many-body messages into equivariant message passing, reaching high accuracy with only two layers and balancing the accuracy and speed of interatomic potentials.

p.t: Learning local equivariant representations for large-scale atomistic dynamics
p.d: 提出不依赖消息传递、严格局域的等变原子间势 Allegro，便于大规模并行，可在保持精度的同时模拟上亿原子的体系。
p.e: Introduces Allegro, a strictly local equivariant interatomic potential without message passing that parallelises easily and can simulate systems of hundreds of millions of atoms while keeping accuracy.

p.t: Equiformer: Equivariant Graph Attention Transformer for 3D Atomistic Graphs
p.d: 在化学与材料场景下，Equiformer 把 Transformer 注意力推广到 SE(3) 等变特征，在分子性质和催化剂吸附能、力的预测上取得领先表现。
p.e: In chemistry and materials settings, Equiformer extends Transformer attention to SE(3)-equivariant features and leads on predicting molecular properties and catalyst adsorption energies and forces.

p.m: Nature Computational Science 2022 · 近年代表
p.t: A universal graph deep learning interatomic potential for the periodic table
p.d: 利用 Materials Project 的结构弛豫数据训练包含三体相互作用的图网络势 M3GNet，可用于周期表中大多数元素组成的材料。
p.e: Trains M3GNet, a graph network potential with three-body interactions, on structural relaxation data from the Materials Project, applicable to materials made of most elements of the periodic table.

p.m: Nature Machine Intelligence 2023 · 已有扩展
p.t: CHGNet as a pretrained universal neural network potential for charge-informed atomistic modelling
p.d: 在约一百五十万个结构上预训练通用神经网络势 CHGNet，并用磁矩信息反映原子电荷状态，可模拟电池材料中的离子迁移与电荷转移。
p.e: Pretrains the universal neural network potential CHGNet on about 1.5 million structures and uses magnetic moments to reflect atomic charge states, enabling simulation of ion migration and charge transfer in battery materials.

p.t: A foundation model for atomistic materials chemistry
p.d: 在 Materials Project 数据上训练 MACE 架构的通用基础势，展示其在水、催化、分子晶体等多种体系的分子动力学中可直接使用或少量微调。
p.e: Trains a universal foundation potential with the MACE architecture on Materials Project data, showing it can be used directly or with light fine-tuning for molecular dynamics of water, catalysis, molecular crystals and more.

p.m: Physical Review Letters 2018 · 较早入口
p.t: Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks for an Accurate and Interpretable Prediction of Material Properties
p.d: 提出晶体图卷积神经网络，把晶体中的原子和化学键表示为图，直接从结构预测形成能、带隙等性质，并能给出局部环境的贡献解释。
p.e: Introduces crystal graph convolutional neural networks, which represent the atoms and bonds of a crystal as a graph, predict properties such as formation energy and band gap directly from structure, and explain contributions of local environments.

p.m: Chemistry of Materials 2019 · 近年代表
p.t: Graph Networks as a Universal Machine Learning Framework for Molecules and Crystals
p.d: 提出带全局状态的图网络框架 MEGNet，可同时用于分子和晶体性质预测，并能把温度、压强等状态量纳入模型。
p.e: Introduces MEGNet, a graph network framework with a global state that handles both molecular and crystal property prediction and can include state variables such as temperature and pressure.

p.m: npj Computational Materials 2021 · 已有扩展
p.t: Atomistic Line Graph Neural Network for improved materials property predictions
p.d: 在原子图之外构建线图来显式表示键角信息，交替在两种图上传递消息，在 JARVIS 和 Materials Project 的多数性质上提高了预测精度。
p.e: Builds a line graph alongside the atom graph to represent bond angles explicitly, alternating message passing between the two, and improves accuracy on most JARVIS and Materials Project properties.

p.t: Commentary: The Materials Project: A materials genome approach to accelerating materials innovation
p.d: 介绍 Materials Project 开放数据库，它用高通量 DFT 计算大量无机材料的性质，成为后来众多材料机器学习模型的数据基础。
p.e: Introduces the open Materials Project database, which computes properties of many inorganic materials with high-throughput DFT and became the data foundation for many later materials machine learning models.

p.m: npj Computational Materials 2020 · 近年代表
p.t: Benchmarking materials property prediction methods: the Matbench test set and Automatminer reference algorithm
p.d: 构建包含十三项任务的材料性质预测基准 Matbench，并提供自动化机器学习基线 Automatminer，使不同方法可以在同一标准下比较。
p.e: Builds Matbench, a 13-task materials property prediction benchmark, with the automated machine learning baseline Automatminer, so methods can be compared on the same footing.

p.t: The Open Materials 2024 (OMat24) inorganic materials dataset and models
p.d: 发布包含一亿多个无机材料结构（大量为非平衡构型）的 DFT 数据集和在其上训练的模型，以提升通用原子间势在远离平衡态时的可靠性。
p.e: Releases a DFT dataset of over 100 million inorganic structures, many of them far from equilibrium, together with models trained on it, to make universal interatomic potentials more reliable away from equilibrium.

p.m: npj Computational Materials 2022 · 近年代表
p.t: Crystal twins: self-supervised learning for crystalline material property prediction
p.d: 借鉴孪生网络自监督方法，在未标注晶体结构上预训练图网络，再微调用于性质预测，在多个小数据任务上优于从头训练。
p.e: Adapts twin-network self-supervised learning to pretrain graph networks on unlabelled crystal structures and fine-tune them for property prediction, outperforming training from scratch on several small-data tasks.

p.m: Nature Machine Intelligence 2023 · 已有扩展
p.t: A multi-modal pre-training transformer for universal transfer learning in metal–organic frameworks
p.d: 从材料表示学习的角度看，该工作把局部原子图和全局能量网格两种模态结合起来做大规模预训练，展示了多模态迁移学习在多孔材料性质预测中的优势。
p.e: From a materials-representation perspective, this work pretrains at scale on two modalities, a local atom graph and a global energy grid, showing the advantage of multimodal transfer learning for predicting properties of porous materials.

p.t: Crystal Diffusion Variational Autoencoder for Periodic Material Generation
p.d: 提出晶体扩散变分自编码器，先预测组成和晶格，再用等变去噪过程生成原子坐标，是周期性材料生成的代表性入口。
p.e: Introduces the crystal diffusion variational autoencoder, which first predicts composition and lattice and then generates atomic coordinates by equivariant denoising; a representative entry point to periodic materials generation.

p.t: Crystal Structure Prediction by Joint Equivariant Diffusion
p.d: 用周期等变的扩散模型同时生成晶格和分数坐标，在给定组成的晶体结构预测任务上优于以往生成方法。
p.e: Generates lattices and fractional coordinates jointly with a periodic-equivariant diffusion model, outperforming earlier generative methods on crystal structure prediction for a given composition.

p.t: Fine-Tuned Language Models Generate Stable Inorganic Materials as Text
p.d: 把晶体结构编码为文本并微调大语言模型生成新材料，发现其生成的结构中亚稳定材料比例较高，且可通过文本提示施加条件。
p.e: Encodes crystal structures as text and fine-tunes large language models to generate new materials, finding a high fraction of metastable structures and allowing conditioning through text prompts.

p.t: FlowMM: Generating Materials with Riemannian Flow Matching
p.d: 把流匹配推广到适合晶体对称性的黎曼流形，用于晶体结构预测和从头生成，比扩散模型以更少积分步数得到稳定结构。
p.e: Extends flow matching to Riemannian manifolds suited to crystal symmetry for structure prediction and de novo generation, reaching stable structures with fewer integration steps than diffusion models.

p.t: Inverse Design of Solid-State Materials via a Continuous Representation
p.d: 把晶体表示为可逆的连续图像式表示并训练生成模型，在钒氧化物体系中逆向设计出此前未知的稳定或亚稳结构。
p.e: Represents crystals with an invertible continuous image-like representation and trains a generative model on it, inversely designing previously unknown stable or metastable structures in the vanadium oxide system.

p.t: MOFDiff: Coarse-grained Diffusion for Metal-Organic Framework Design
p.d: 从材料生成方法的角度看，MOFDiff 把复杂框架材料粗粒化为构筑单元再做扩散生成，展示了生成模型如何扩展到原子数很多的周期性材料。
p.e: From a materials-generation perspective, MOFDiff coarse-grains complex framework materials into building blocks before diffusion generation, showing how generative models scale to periodic materials with very many atoms.

p.t: A generative model for inorganic materials design
p.d: 提出面向无机材料的扩散生成模型 MatterGen，可按化学组成、对称性和力学、磁学等性质条件生成稳定新材料，并实验合成了其中一个设计。
p.e: Introduces MatterGen, a diffusion model for inorganic materials that generates stable new materials conditioned on chemistry, symmetry and mechanical or magnetic properties, and experimentally synthesised one design.

p.m: Chemistry of Materials 2017 · 较早入口
p.t: Predicting the Thermodynamic Stability of Solids Combining Density Functional Theory and Machine Learning
p.d: 在大量立方钙钛矿的 DFT 数据上训练模型预测热力学稳定性，用机器学习先行筛选再以 DFT 验证，大幅减少计算量。
p.e: Trains models on DFT data for many cubic perovskites to predict thermodynamic stability, screening first with machine learning and then verifying with DFT to cut computation sharply.

p.t: Accelerated discovery of stable lead-free hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites via machine learning
p.d: 用机器学习从五千多种候选中预测带隙等性质，再结合 DFT 筛选出稳定且适合光伏的无铅杂化有机无机钙钛矿。
p.e: Uses machine learning to predict band gaps and other properties for over 5,000 candidates, then combines it with DFT to identify stable lead-free hybrid organic–inorganic perovskites suitable for photovoltaics.

p.t: Scaling deep learning for materials discovery
p.d: 通过图网络预测与 DFT 验证的主动学习循环不断扩大规模，预测出约两百二十万个新晶体结构，其中约三十八万个位于凸包上。
p.e: Scales up through an active-learning loop of graph network prediction and DFT verification, predicting about 2.2 million new crystal structures, roughly 380,000 of them on the convex hull.

p.t: Predicting reaction performance in C–N cross-coupling using machine learning
p.d: 基于数千个高通量实验的 Buchwald–Hartwig 偶联反应数据，用随机森林和化学描述符预测产率，并能推广到未见过的添加剂。
p.e: Predicts yields from thousands of high-throughput Buchwald–Hartwig coupling experiments using random forests and chemical descriptors, generalising to additives not seen in training.

p.t: A graph-convolutional neural network model for the prediction of chemical reactivity
p.d: 用图卷积网络预测反应中可能变化的化学键，再生成并排序候选产物，在美国专利反应数据上达到接近化学家的预测准确率。
p.e: Uses graph convolutional networks to predict which bonds are likely to change in a reaction, then generates and ranks candidate products, approaching chemist-level accuracy on US patent reactions.

p.m: ACS Central Science 2019 · 已有扩展
p.t: Molecular Transformer: A Model for Uncertainty-Calibrated Chemical Reaction Prediction
p.d: 把反应产物预测视为从反应物到产物的 SMILES 翻译任务，用 Transformer 取得很高准确率，并提供校准良好的置信度估计。
p.e: Treats reaction product prediction as SMILES translation from reactants to products, achieving high accuracy with a Transformer and providing well-calibrated confidence estimates.

p.t: Planning chemical syntheses with deep neural networks and symbolic AI
p.d: 从化学合成的角度看，该工作用上千万条已知反应学习转化规则，并以蒙特卡洛树搜索组合成多步路线，标志着计算机辅助合成规划进入数据驱动阶段。
p.e: From a chemical-synthesis perspective, this work learns transformation rules from millions of known reactions and assembles multi-step routes with Monte Carlo tree search, marking the shift of computer-aided synthesis planning to a data-driven era.

p.t: Retro*: Learning Retrosynthetic Planning with Neural Guided A* Search
p.d: 从合成规划算法的角度看，Retro* 把多步逆合成建模为与或树搜索，用神经网络估计剩余合成代价，以更少搜索找到更短、更便宜的路线。
p.e: From a synthesis-planning-algorithm perspective, Retro* models multi-step retrosynthesis as AND-OR tree search with a neural estimate of remaining synthesis cost, finding shorter, cheaper routes with less search.

p.t: Deep Retrosynthetic Reaction Prediction using Local Reactivity and Global Attention
p.d: 从化学直觉的角度看，LocalRetro 利用反应只改变局部原子和键的原理，在反应中心上预测模板，同时用注意力捕捉远程官能团影响，提高单步逆合成准确率。
p.e: From the standpoint of chemical intuition, LocalRetro uses the principle that reactions change only local atoms and bonds, predicting templates at reaction centres while attention captures remote functional-group effects, improving single-step retrosynthesis accuracy.

p.t: A robotic platform for flow synthesis of organic compounds informed by AI planning
p.d: 把计算机合成规划与可重构的机器人流动化学平台结合，自动规划并执行多种药物分子的多步合成，化学家只需少量干预。
p.e: Combines computer synthesis planning with a reconfigurable robotic flow chemistry platform to plan and execute multi-step syntheses of several drug molecules automatically, with little chemist intervention.

p.m: ACS Central Science 2018 · 较早入口
p.t: Phoenics: A Bayesian Optimizer for Chemistry
p.d: 提出面向化学实验的贝叶斯优化算法 Phoenics，用贝叶斯神经网络建模并支持并行提出多个实验，适合自动化实验平台使用。
p.e: Introduces Phoenics, a Bayesian optimization algorithm for chemistry experiments that models with Bayesian neural networks and proposes several experiments in parallel, suited to automated platforms.

p.t: Bayesian reaction optimization as a tool for chemical synthesis
p.d: 开发面向合成化学的贝叶斯优化工具并与化学家进行对比，发现算法在反应条件优化中平均所需实验更少、结果更稳定。
p.e: Develops a Bayesian optimization tool for synthetic chemistry and compares it with chemists, finding that the algorithm needs fewer experiments on average and gives more consistent results in reaction optimisation.

p.t: Closed-loop optimization of general reaction conditions for heteroaryl Suzuki-Miyaura coupling
p.d: 结合机器学习与机器人实验进行闭环优化，寻找对大量杂芳基底物都表现良好的 Suzuki–Miyaura 偶联通用条件，使平均产率明显提高。
p.e: Runs closed-loop optimisation with machine learning and robotic experiments to find general Suzuki–Miyaura coupling conditions that work well across many heteroaryl substrates, clearly raising average yields.

p.t: Accelerated discovery of CO2 electrocatalysts using active machine learning
p.d: 用主动学习结合 DFT 计算筛选大量金属间化合物表面，找到铜铝合金作为 CO₂ 电还原制乙烯的候选，并经实验验证具有很高效率。
p.e: Screens many intermetallic surfaces with active learning and DFT, identifying copper–aluminium alloys as candidates for CO₂ electroreduction to ethylene, with high efficiency confirmed experimentally.

p.t: Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20) Dataset and Community Challenges
p.d: 发布包含一百多万次表面吸附 DFT 弛豫计算的 OC20 数据集，并定义能量、力和弛豫结构预测等标准任务，推动了催化机器学习的发展。
p.e: Releases the OC20 dataset of over a million DFT relaxations of surface adsorbates and defines standard tasks such as energy, force and relaxed-structure prediction, driving progress in machine learning for catalysis.

p.t: The Open Catalyst 2022 (OC22) Dataset and Challenges for Oxide Electrocatalysts
p.d: 在 OC20 基础上发布面向氧化物电催化剂的 OC22 数据集，覆盖更复杂的表面和电子结构，用于析氧反应等能源催化场景。
p.e: Builds on OC20 with the OC22 dataset for oxide electrocatalysts, covering more complex surfaces and electronic structure for energy catalysis such as the oxygen evolution reaction.

p.t: Active learning across intermetallics to guide discovery of electrocatalysts for CO2 reduction and H2 evolution
p.d: 构建自动化 DFT 与机器学习主动学习流程，在上千种金属间化合物表面上预测吸附能，筛选出 CO₂ 还原和析氢反应的候选催化剂。
p.e: Builds an automated DFT and machine learning active-learning workflow that predicts adsorption energies on thousands of intermetallic surfaces, identifying candidate catalysts for CO₂ reduction and hydrogen evolution.

p.m: npj Computational Materials 2023 · 近年代表
p.t: AdsorbML: a leap in efficiency for adsorption energy calculations using generalizable machine learning potentials
p.d: 先用通用机器学习势对大量吸附构型做弛豫和排序，再只对最优几个做 DFT 验证，在保持准确率的同时把吸附能计算成本降低约两千倍。
p.e: Relaxes and ranks many adsorption configurations with a general machine-learned potential and verifies only the best few with DFT, cutting the cost of adsorption-energy calculations about 2,000-fold while keeping accuracy.

p.t: Data-driven prediction of battery cycle life before capacity degradation
p.d: 从商用磷酸铁锂电池前一百个充放电循环中提取特征，在容量明显衰减之前就能较准确地预测电池循环寿命。
p.e: Extracts features from the first 100 charge–discharge cycles of commercial lithium iron phosphate cells to predict cycle life accurately before capacity visibly fades.

p.t: Closed-loop optimization of fast-charging protocols for batteries with machine learning
p.d: 把早期寿命预测模型与贝叶斯优化结合成闭环，从两百多种快充协议中找出长寿命方案，所需实验时间从约五百天缩短到十六天。
p.e: Combines an early-life prediction model with Bayesian optimization in a closed loop to find long-life protocols among more than 200 fast-charging protocols, cutting experiment time from about 500 days to 16.

p.m: Journal of the American Chemical Society 2024 · 已有扩展
p.t: Accelerating Computational Materials Discovery with Machine Learning and Cloud High-Performance Computing: from Large-Scale Screening to Experimental Validation
p.d: 结合机器学习势与云端高性能计算，从三千多万种候选中逐级筛选固态电解质，并实验合成了一种可减少锂用量的新材料。
p.e: Combines machine-learned potentials with cloud high-performance computing to screen over 30 million candidates step by step for solid electrolytes, and experimentally synthesises a new material that uses less lithium.

p.t: Unsupervised word embeddings capture latent knowledge from materials science literature
p.d: 在三百多万篇材料科学摘要上训练无监督词向量，发现其中隐含材料性质知识，并能提前数年推荐后来被报道的热电材料。
p.e: Trains unsupervised word embeddings on over 3 million materials science abstracts, finding latent knowledge of material properties and recommending thermoelectric materials years before they were reported.

p.t: Text-mined dataset of inorganic materials synthesis recipes
p.d: 用自然语言处理从文献中自动抽取无机材料固相合成的前驱体、步骤和条件，构建了包含约三万条配方的开放数据集。
p.e: Uses natural language processing to extract precursors, steps and conditions of solid-state syntheses of inorganic materials from the literature, building an open dataset of about 30,000 recipes.

p.t: Structured information extraction from scientific text with large language models
p.d: 从通用化学与材料信息抽取的角度看，该工作微调大语言模型同时识别实体和关系，把掺杂、金属有机框架和一般材料文献转为可直接入库的结构化记录。
p.e: From the angle of general chemistry and materials information extraction, this work fine-tunes large language models to recognise entities and relations together, turning literature on doping, metal–organic frameworks and general materials into structured records ready for databases.

p.m: Nature Machine Intelligence 2024 · 近年代表
p.t: Leveraging large language models for predictive chemistry
p.d: 把分子和材料性质预测、反应产率等问题写成自然语言问答并微调大语言模型，发现在小数据条件下其表现可比肩甚至超过专用机器学习模型。
p.e: Writes molecular and materials property prediction and reaction yield problems as natural-language questions and fine-tunes large language models, finding that in low-data settings they match or beat dedicated machine learning models.

p.t: A framework for evaluating the chemical knowledge and reasoning abilities of large language models against the expertise of chemists
p.d: 构建包含两千多道化学问答题的评测框架，比较大语言模型与化学家的表现，发现最好的模型整体上超过人类专家，但在部分基础问题上仍会出错且过度自信。
p.e: Builds an evaluation framework of more than 2,000 chemistry questions to compare large language models with chemists, finding that the best models outperform human experts overall yet still make mistakes on some basic questions and are overconfident.

p.m: Angewandte Chemie International Edition 2023 · 较早入口
p.t: A GPT-4 Reticular Chemist for Guiding MOF Discovery
p.d: 从化学智能体的角度看，该工作是人机协同实验的早期范例：化学家按 GPT-4 的建议逐轮进行合成与表征并反馈结果，展示了语言模型参与实验设计的可行流程。
p.e: From a chemistry-agent perspective, this is an early example of human–AI collaborative experimentation: chemists ran synthesis and characterisation round by round on GPT-4's suggestions and fed back results, showing a workable way for language models to take part in experimental design.

p.m: Nature Machine Intelligence 2024 · 近年代表
p.t: Augmenting large language models with chemistry tools
p.d: 从化学工具链的角度看，ChemCrow 把逆合成、性质计算、安全检查等十多种专家工具接入大语言模型，使其能可靠地完成多步化学任务并驱动自动化合成平台。
p.e: From a chemistry-toolchain perspective, ChemCrow connects more than ten expert tools, including retrosynthesis, property calculation and safety checks, to a large language model, letting it reliably complete multi-step chemistry tasks and drive an automated synthesis platform.

p.t: A mobile robotic chemist
p.d: 从化学实验自动化的角度看，该工作让移动机器人在为人设计的实验室中操作多台仪器，结合贝叶斯优化自主完成数百次实验，找到更高活性的光催化析氢配方。
p.e: From a lab-automation perspective, this work has a mobile robot operate several instruments in a laboratory designed for humans and, with Bayesian optimization, autonomously run hundreds of experiments to find a more active photocatalytic hydrogen-evolution formulation.

p.t: An autonomous laboratory for the accelerated synthesis of inorganic materials
p.d: 构建面向无机粉末材料的自主实验室，结合计算预测、文献训练的配方推荐和主动学习，在十七天内连续运行并报告合成了多种目标无机材料。
p.e: Builds an autonomous laboratory for inorganic powders that combines computational predictions, literature-trained recipe recommendations and active learning, running continuously for 17 days and reporting the synthesis of several target inorganic materials.

p.t: Autonomous chemical research with large language models
p.d: 从化学研究流程的角度看，Coscientist 让大语言模型检索文献、编写仪器控制代码并调用液体处理机器人，自主完成钯催化偶联反应的设计、执行与条件优化。
p.e: From a chemical-research-workflow perspective, Coscientist has a large language model search the literature, write instrument-control code and drive a liquid-handling robot, autonomously designing, running and optimising palladium-catalysed coupling reactions.

p.t: Autonomous mobile robots for exploratory synthetic chemistry
p.d: 让移动机器人在多台通用仪器之间运送样品，并综合核磁与质谱等表征数据自动判断结果，用于结构多样化学和超分子组装等探索性合成。
p.e: Has mobile robots carry samples between several general-purpose instruments and automatically judge outcomes by combining NMR, mass spectrometry and other data, for exploratory synthesis such as structural diversification and supramolecular assembly.

p.m: npj Computational Materials 2020 · 较早入口
p.t: A critical examination of compound stability predictions from machine-learned formation energies
p.d: 指出机器学习模型即使形成能误差较小，在判断化合物是否热力学稳定时仍可能表现很差，因为稳定性取决于能量差而非绝对值。
p.e: Shows that machine learning models with small formation-energy errors can still perform poorly at judging whether compounds are thermodynamically stable, because stability depends on energy differences rather than absolute values.

p.m: Nature Machine Intelligence 2025 · 近年代表
p.t: A framework to evaluate machine learning crystal stability predictions
p.d: 构建模拟真实材料筛选流程的前瞻性基准 Matbench Discovery，用分类指标评估各类模型预测晶体稳定性的能力，发现通用原子间势表现最好。
p.e: Builds Matbench Discovery, a prospective benchmark that mimics real materials screening and uses classification metrics to evaluate how well models predict crystal stability, finding that universal interatomic potentials perform best.

p.m: Chemistry of Materials 2024 · 已有扩展
p.t: Artificial Intelligence Driving Materials Discovery? Perspective on the Article: Scaling Deep Learning for Materials Discovery
p.d: 从固体化学角度审视 GNoME 预测的材料，指出其中许多结构并不新颖或缺乏实际可行性，提醒需要区分“新化合物”与“有用材料”。
p.e: Examines GNoME's predicted materials from a solid-state chemistry perspective, arguing that many structures are not novel or lack practical relevance, and urging a distinction between "new compounds" and "useful materials".

p.t: Challenges in High-Throughput Inorganic Materials Prediction and Autonomous Synthesis
p.d: 重新分析自主实验室报告的粉末衍射数据，指出部分产物的结构解析与新颖性判断存在问题，呼吁自主合成结果采用更严格的表征标准。
p.e: Reanalyses the powder diffraction data reported by an autonomous laboratory, pointing out problems with some structure assignments and novelty claims, and calls for stricter characterisation standards for autonomous synthesis.
